item.title: Geko Yuusha ~Sake wa Nomanedo Shuchinikurin!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Caramel BOX Ichigo-aji
  • 発売日: 2021-06-25
  • スコア: 6.34/10 (38 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 下戸勇者 ～酒は飲まねど酒池肉林!～
  • 英語名: Geko Yuusha Sake wa Nomanedo Shuchinikurin!

あらすじ

Once upon a time, there was a brave man who traveled alone.

He couldn’t drink alcohol, so he couldn’t recruit friends in the right places.

He continued his long and arduous journey alone, with only his conviction to defeat the Demon King.

He overcame many hardships by himself and finally arrived at the Demon Lord’s castle.

item.title: Haji Kano ~Kimi ga Iru Heya~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Caramel BOX Ichigo-aji
  • 発売日: 2020-02-28
  • スコア: 6.959999999999999/10 (50 人評価)
  • 日本語名: はじカノ～君がいる部屋～
  • 英語名: Haji Kano Kimi ga Iru Heya

あらすじ

It’s been two years since Naoki became a working adult. There hasn’t been any particularly good or bad things; it’s been extremely normal and peaceful. However, he was lacking excitement in his life.

With the arrival of spring, he rapidly got closer to three girls: the helpful but naive Mai, his cheeky tomboy imouto Yuana, and his boss Misaki, who seemed outside of his league. A trivial incident one day leads to him falling in love with one of them, and soon they begin living together, bringing moments of happiness that they have not felt until now.

item.title: Toppara ~Zashikiwarashi no Hanashi~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Caramel BOX Ichigo-aji
  • 発売日: 2008-09-26
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (62 人評価)
  • 日本語名: とっぱら～ざしきわらしのはなし～
  • 英語名: Toppara Zashikiwarashi no Hanashi

あらすじ

The player takes the role of Itsukaichi Keiji, a teenager that lives by himself in the town of Tokieda, with his closest living relative being his granduncle, an author and researcher of the paranormal. Our protagonist has the peculiar ability to recognize supernatural beings with ease as well as the ability to see ghosts and other entities not visible to normal humans. Due to a complicated set of circumstances, Keiji has a strong hatred for ghosts and phantoms (also known as youkai), blaming them for the problems in his life.
